author: Debra Morrison
text: You're not supposed to check at the same time. Abbott says you check your libre 15 minutes after finger stick. They have a video showing it's like a train. Also night time lows are usually compression lows

author: Andrew Entrekin
text: I find the Libre 3 and 3 +'s are usually 10-18 points higher than actual. Many times about 5 to 7 days after applying the sensor they start getting a little bit more accurate. If yours is that far off in another 48 hours I would call Abbott Labs support and get it replaced
